_doc: clinic-hold-lapses — the honesty of the hold itself.
hold_slot() is the only write an agent can make, and the claim on the page is that it books
NOTHING: it auto-releases when the 45-second TTL lapses. This case waits out the full TTL with
no keyboard input and asserts the slot LEFT the visitor's hands (back to open, or taken in the
meantime — either is honest; 'still held' or 'booked' would be the lie), that nothing anywhere
was booked, that the dock disarmed, and that clinic_hold_status reports no live hold.
